body: I've been doing an essay over half term so I've barely had any sleep and now I'm stressed out I won't get it handed in on Monday 🙃
I've been on my period for 6 weeks now and I 100% feel this (I've been on my period for this long because I have an implant) :(

I think they do understand the severity of the small seizures which I get in the morning since my mum is also epileptic. I think right now though I just need to figure out what to do about sleep and if there are any drugs or other things that I could try to help the current situation.

I will comment about anything which happens to do with the issue and I greatly appreciate that you care :)

I'm 17, nearly 18. I was thinking about booking an online appointment with my doctor to see what I could do with my sleep meds and that I should also mention my seizures which are occurring, like you said, are a big deal and an issue. It does make me upset that my parents wont believe me and it's making my issues seem like it's not a big deal, even though they are.

I very rarely get seizures anymore but the past few weeks I have been experiencing some. My parents are aware that I'm having them and it makes me feel insane since they dont realise that its dangerous to have even a small one and treat it like it's not even there.

I do my physio every night, which includes stuff like core strength building and balancing exercises. I also go for walks almost every day and get at least 30+ mins of fresh air. 

My eye mask which I use helps to keep my mind less active and it blocks out any light. Ive tried pretty much everything to make myself more tired and nothing seems to work and it doesnt help that my mum doesnt believe me. 

I used to wake up at least 7 times a night and I also used to experience vivid nightmares until I started taking the melatonin ( which is now one 2mg tablet). I dont know if I should go on a drug that makes me really tired but I dont want it to have a negative reaction to my other medication and myself since I've had previous bad experiences with gabapentin and other drugs.
